text: 中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》。其中指出，强化企业科技创新主体地位。加强普惠激励政策供给，建立企业研发准备金制度，强化企业科技投入主导作用。鼓励科技型中小企业加大研发投入，提高企业研发费用加计扣除比例。将符合国家战略需求的企业研发项目按程序上升为国家项目，鼓励企业牵头国家科技任务，支持有能力的民营企业牵头承担国家重大技术攻关任务。建立用户考核评价成果的机制，强化企业成果转化主体地位。健全国有企业推进原始创新制度安排。支持专精特新中小企业发展。（新华社）
text_en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council issued the "Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces." It states that the dominant role of enterprises in scientific and technological innovation should be strengthened. The supply of inclusive incentive policies should be increased, a enterprise R&D reserve fund system should be established, and enterprises' leading role in scientific and technological investment should be strengthened. Technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises should be encouraged to increase R&D investment, and the proportion of superdeduction for enterprise R&D expenses should be raised. Enterprise R&D projects that meet national strategic needs should be elevated to national projects according to procedures, enterprises should be encouraged to lead national science and technology tasks, and capable private enterprises should be supported in leading major national technological breakthrough tasks. A mechanism for assessing and evaluating outcomes by users should be established, and enterprises' dominant role in transforming outcomes should be strengthened. The institutional arrangements for state-owned enterprises to promote original innovation should be improved. Specialized, refined, distinctive and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises should be supported in their development. (Xinhua News Agency)
